notes.subject: נשקף
notes.rationale: lit. 'lean out (of a window) and gaze'; rendered 'jira ɲɛda' (show the face), the leaning-out picture is softened

notes.subject: נשקף
notes.rationale: answers v.11's נשקו (kiss): heaven bends out toward earth that has sprouted — the sound-link is untranslatable

notes.subject: צצמח
notes.rationale: 'sprout' as a shoot (compare the Branch, tsémach); Bambara wɔrɔ keeps the growing picture

translation: Tiɲɛ bɛ wɔrɔ dugukolo la, ani tileya bɛ ɲɛda jira sankolow la.
